title: Cosmic Rabbit and Serpent
description: A surreal desert scene featuring a giant brown rabbit leaping down a sand dune while a purple-skinned woman with flowing multicolored hair rides its back. She holds a blue snake and has her mouth open as if shouting, set against a cosmic background with a swirling rainbow vortex, planets, shooting stars, and ancient ruins.
prompt: A vibrant surreal painting of a giant brown rabbit leaping across a rippling sand dune in a desert landscape with cacti and ancient stone ruins. A purple-skinned woman with long flowing red, orange, and yellow hair rides on its back, mouth open shouting, holding a large blue snake in her hands. Behind them a massive swirling cosmic vortex of rainbow colors filled with planets, shooting stars, and floating orbs in a starry night sky.
